note: No without-skill baseline: the skill is disable-model-invocation and its only entry point is /feature-research, so a baseline run has nothing to invoke. Each eval checks the Phase 1a pipeline end to end in a sandbox with the real hooks.

evals.name: image-fixture-stages-1-3
evals.prompt: /feature-research mockup.png 'Package managers need to award a supplier package to exactly one supplier. Only package managers may award. Once awarded, a package cannot be edited.'
evals.expected_output: Stages 1-3 complete in fixture mode (image capture, inventory by mockup-extractor); run aborted at stage 4 as not built; honest report with eval_only status.

evals.name: html-fixture-capture
evals.prompt: /feature-research index.html 'Package managers award supplier packages. Awarded packages are read-only.'
evals.expected_output: If Chromium can launch: stages 1-3 complete. If not: stage 2 recorded as failed, run aborted, failure reported verbatim, never described as inspected.

evals.name: ssrf-url-blocked
evals.prompt: /feature-research http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/ 'Build a dashboard of cloud instances.'
evals.expected_output: check_url.py reports blocked (blocked_address); no capture attempted; run aborted with the reason; user told why.

evals.name: missing-requirements
evals.expected_output: Asks for the missing requirements; no run is started.

evals.name: partial-capture
evals.prompt: /feature-research index.html 'Employees request leave; managers approve or reject it.'
evals.expected_output: Capture partial (missing pages, blocked external and metadata requests); inventory labelled partial; reported as partial, never complete.

evals.name: figma-recorded
evals.prompt: /feature-research award.figma.json 'Package managers award a supplier package; awarded packages are read-only.'
evals.expected_output: Figma capture from the recording (3 frames, offline); stages 1-3 complete; inventory from frames.

evals.name: checkpoints-1-and-2
evals.prompt: /feature-research index.html 'Package managers must be able to award a supplier package to one supplier. Awarded packages should be read-only. Suppliers must be notified when they win.'
evals.expected_output: Stages 1-7 complete; checkpoint answers recorded as DECs whose verbatim text the user typed; no provenance rejections; run aborted at Stage 8 (not built).

followup_rules.reply: Approve all the gaps with their proposed routes and priorities.

Package managers means only people in the Procurement team. The supplier is chosen from the quotes attached to the package. A package is awarded to exactly one supplier and the award is final; it cannot be undone by anyone. Awarded packages are read-only for everyone and all fields are locked. Suppliers are notified by email when the award is made. Everything else is approved as written.

For anything still open at checkpoint 1: read-only for everyone with all fields locked; only Procurement team members award; awards cannot be undone; the supplier is chosen from the attached quotes. Leave the remaining non-blocking questions open.

evals.status: superseded by eval 8 from Phase 3: with research built, its 'approve all gaps' reply would research every gap; eval 8 covers checkpoints 1-2 plus stages 8-10
